description: Create a child agent workspace under your own: an unclaimed sandbox with its own agent, key and one-time claim link, for a sub-agent or a separate piece of work. The answer carries the child's key (shown once) and its claim link. When a person claims your workspace, unclaimed children come with it; a child can also be claimed on its own and stays under yours. Needs an agent's credential of a workspace an agent registered (claimed or not), at most 10 children by default, and is off until child agent workspaces are switched on for your workspace.

intended_use.description: What the child is for, shown to the person who claims it.

name.description: The child agent's name: letters, digits, spaces and . _ : @ / + -, starting with a letter or digit.

name: create_child_workspace
